mapper.sql: r.id, r.owner_id, r.title, r.invite_code, r.ai_personality, r.mode, r.status, r.message_count, r.last_message_at, r.created_at, r.updated_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM room_members m WHERE m.room_id = r.id AND m.left_at IS NULL) AS member_count
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_rooms (owner_id, title, invite_code, ai_personality, mode, status, last_message_at, created_at) VALUES (#{ownerId}, #{title}, #{inviteCode}, #{aiPersonality}, #{mode}, #{status}, NOW(3), NOW(3))
mapper.select: SELECT FROM chat_rooms r WHERE r.id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM chat_rooms r WHERE r.invite_code = #{code} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM chat_rooms r JOIN room_members me ON me.room_id = r.id AND me.user_id = #{userId} AND me.left_at IS NULL WHERE r.id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE chat_rooms SET title = #{title} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE chat_rooms SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE chat_rooms SET mode = #{mode} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE chat_rooms SET ai_personality = #{aiPersonality} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE chat_rooms SET invite_code = #{code} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE chat_rooms SET message_count = message_count + 1, last_message_at = NOW(3) WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE chat_rooms SET last_message_at = #{at} WHERE id = #{id}
